title: Why is Queen Victoria so controversial? - Carolyn Harris
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】維多利亞女王為何如此備受爭議？ ——卡洛琳‧哈里斯（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Order, order! Who do we have on the stand today?
cues.en: Order, order! Who do we have on the stand today?
cues.zh: 下令，下令！今天的證人席上有誰？

cues.text: Queen Victoria... wasn’t she the definition of straight laced?
cues.en: Queen Victoria... wasn’t she the definition of straight laced?
cues.zh: 維多利亞女王……她不是直系蕾絲的定義嗎？

cues.text: Indeed, Your Honor.
cues.en: Indeed, Your Honor.
cues.zh: 確實如此，法官大人。

cues.text: Throughout her 63-year reign, she was a tireless model of morality and restraint.
cues.en: Throughout her 63-year reign, she was a tireless model of morality and restraint.
cues.zh: 在她 63 年的統治生涯中，她是一位不知疲倦的道德和剋制典範。

cues.text: So much so that the 19th century is popularly called the “Victorian Age”
cues.en: So much so that the 19th century is popularly called the “Victorian Age”
cues.zh: 以至於19世紀普遍被稱為“維多利亞時代”

cues.text: and is still associated with those very qualities.
cues.en: and is still associated with those very qualities.
cues.zh: 並且仍然與這些品質相關。

cues.text: Unfortunately, this era is also associated with rigid gender roles,
cues.en: Unfortunately, this era is also associated with rigid gender roles,
cues.zh: 不幸的是，這個時代也伴隨著僵化的性別角色，

cues.text: deep class divisions, and the subjugation of colonized peoples—
cues.en: deep class divisions, and the subjugation of colonized peoples—
cues.zh: 深刻的階級分歧與對殖民地人民的征服——

cues.text: all reinforced by Queen Victoria's so-called virtues.
cues.en: all reinforced by Queen Victoria's so-called virtues.
cues.zh: 維多利亞女王所謂的美德強化了這一切。

cues.text: Her moralistic approach to monarchy was more concerned with making the British Empire look like a big happy family
cues.en: Her moralistic approach to monarchy was more concerned with making the British Empire look like a big happy family
cues.zh: 她對君主制的道德態度更關心讓大英帝國看起來像一個幸福的大家庭

cues.text: than actually helping anyone inside it.
cues.en: than actually helping anyone inside it.
cues.zh: 而不是真正幫助其中的任何人。

cues.text: I guess appearances can be deceiving.
cues.en: I guess appearances can be deceiving.
cues.zh: 我想外表是會騙人的。

cues.text: In her defense, Your Honor, Victoria came to the throne at the tender age of 18
cues.en: In her defense, Your Honor, Victoria came to the throne at the tender age of 18
cues.zh: 法官大人，維多利亞在 18 歲時即位

cues.text: and faced immediate pressure to restore public faith in the crown.
cues.en: and faced immediate pressure to restore public faith in the crown.
cues.zh: 並立即面臨恢復公眾對王室信心的壓力。

cues.text: The previous two kings had been drinkers, womanizers, and gamblers.
cues.en: The previous two kings had been drinkers, womanizers, and gamblers.
cues.zh: 前兩位國王都是酗酒者、好色之徒和賭徒。

cues.text: Meanwhile, Victoria was expected to serve as the country's moral compass
cues.en: Meanwhile, Victoria was expected to serve as the country's moral compass
cues.zh: 同時，維多利亞有望成為國家的道德指南針

cues.text: during the dizzying changes brought by industrialization.
cues.en: during the dizzying changes brought by industrialization.
cues.zh: 在工業化帶來的令人眼花撩亂的變化中。

cues.text: Well, she certainly got her chance.
cues.en: Well, she certainly got her chance.
cues.zh: 好吧，她當然得到了機會。

cues.text: Her reign coincided with the birth of mass media, giving her the power to exert immense cultural influence.
cues.en: Her reign coincided with the birth of mass media, giving her the power to exert immense cultural influence.
cues.zh: 她的統治恰逢大眾媒體的誕生，使她有能力發揮巨大的文化影響力。

cues.text: In newspapers, she appeared as the perfect wife to her beloved Prince Albert.
cues.en: In newspapers, she appeared as the perfect wife to her beloved Prince Albert.
cues.zh: 在報紙上，她以她心愛的阿爾伯特親王的完美妻子的形像出現。

cues.text: Press images of her pure white wedding dress started a fashion trend
cues.en: Press images of her pure white wedding dress started a fashion trend
cues.zh: 她的純白色婚紗的新聞圖片引發了時尚潮流

cues.text: that continues to this day.
cues.en: that continues to this day.
cues.zh: 這種情況一直持續到今天。

cues.text: And front pages featuring their family’s idyllic Christmas celebrations
cues.en: And front pages featuring their family’s idyllic Christmas celebrations
cues.zh: 頭版刊登了他們一堂田園詩般的聖誕節慶祝活動

cues.text: set a new standard for middle class society.
cues.en: set a new standard for middle class society.
cues.zh: 為中產階級社會樹立了新標準。

cues.text: Specifically a standard that shamed any family who couldn’t afford a picture-perfect holiday.
cues.en: Specifically a standard that shamed any family who couldn’t afford a picture-perfect holiday.
cues.zh: 具體來說，這個標準讓那些無力承擔完美假期的家庭感到羞愧。

cues.text: She had to cultivate the image of a dutiful wife and dedicated mother
cues.en: She had to cultivate the image of a dutiful wife and dedicated mother
cues.zh: 她必須樹立一個賢妻良母的形象

cues.text: to meet popular expectations— even though her relationship with her children was sometimes stormy.
cues.en: to meet popular expectations— even though her relationship with her children was sometimes stormy.
cues.zh: 為了滿足大眾的期望——儘管她和孩子的關係有時會很不穩定。

cues.text: Besides, she wasn't entirely traditional.
cues.en: Besides, she wasn't entirely traditional.
cues.zh: 此外，她並不完全傳統。

cues.text: While religious leaders and some doctors argued against using pain medication during childbirth,
cues.en: While religious leaders and some doctors argued against using pain medication during childbirth,
cues.zh: 雖然宗教領袖和一些醫生反對在分娩期間使用止痛藥，

cues.text: Victoria made the practice socially acceptable by using anesthesia
cues.en: Victoria made the practice socially acceptable by using anesthesia
cues.zh: 維多利亞透過使用麻醉使這種做法為社會所接受

cues.text: during the births of two of her children.
cues.en: during the births of two of her children.
cues.zh: 在她的兩個孩子出生期間。

cues.text: And she publicly supported the entry of women into the field of nursing.
cues.en: And she publicly supported the entry of women into the field of nursing.
cues.zh: 她也公開支援女性進入護理領域。

cues.text: She also opposed giving women the right to vote, and believed they should focus on their household responsibilities
cues.en: She also opposed giving women the right to vote, and believed they should focus on their household responsibilities
cues.zh: 她也反對賦予婦女投票權，並認為她們應該專注於家庭責任

cues.text: instead of politics.
cues.en: instead of politics.
cues.zh: 而不是政治。

cues.text: She viewed her position as a powerful woman as an accident of birth,
cues.en: She viewed her position as a powerful woman as an accident of birth,
cues.zh: 她認為自己作為一個有權有勢的女人的地位是與生俱來的，

cues.text: not as a model for her gender.
cues.en: not as a model for her gender.
cues.zh: 不是作為她性別的典範。

cues.text: Well, that's not exactly the most inspiring message.
cues.en: Well, that's not exactly the most inspiring message.
cues.zh: 嗯，這並不是最鼓舞人心的資訊。

cues.text: Victoria simply mirrored and reinforced larger cultural trends;
cues.en: Victoria simply mirrored and reinforced larger cultural trends;
cues.zh: 維多利亞只是反映並強化了更大的文化趨勢；

cues.text: she didn’t create them.
cues.en: she didn’t create them.
cues.zh: 它們不是她創造的。

cues.text: Besides, her public persona was the only reliable tool she had
cues.en: Besides, her public persona was the only reliable tool she had
cues.zh: 此外，她的公眾形像是她唯一可靠的工具

cues.text: for affecting change in Britain.
cues.en: for affecting change in Britain.
cues.zh: 影響英國的變革。

cues.text: As a constitutional monarch, the Queen was expected to act on the advice of her Prime Minister.
cues.en: As a constitutional monarch, the Queen was expected to act on the advice of her Prime Minister.
cues.zh: 身為立憲君主，女王應該按照首相的建議行事。

cues.text: And while some of the ministers she worked with during her reign actively encouraged her to shape Britain’s politics,
cues.en: And while some of the ministers she worked with during her reign actively encouraged her to shape Britain’s politics,
cues.zh: 儘管在她執政期間與她共事的一些大臣積極鼓勵她塑造英國政治，

cues.text: others, like Lord John Russell, dismissed her ideas.
cues.en: others, like Lord John Russell, dismissed her ideas.
cues.zh: 其他人，如約翰·羅素勳爵，則駁回了她的想法。

cues.text: Yet, when Russell’s government failed to address the Irish Potato Famine,
cues.en: Yet, when Russell’s government failed to address the Irish Potato Famine,
cues.zh: 然而，當拉塞爾政府未能解決愛爾蘭馬鈴薯飢荒時，

cues.text: Victoria received the blame.
cues.en: Victoria received the blame.
cues.zh: 維多利亞受到了指責。

cues.text: In fact, she’s still known as the “Famine Queen” to this day.
cues.en: In fact, she’s still known as the “Famine Queen” to this day.
cues.zh: 事實上，直到今天她仍然被稱為「飢荒女王」。

cues.text: That moniker may have more to do with her measly personal donation
cues.en: That moniker may have more to do with her measly personal donation
cues.zh: 這個綽號可能更多地與她微薄的個人捐款有關

cues.text: of £2,000 to famine relief, which was less than 1% of her annual stipend.
cues.en: of £2,000 to famine relief, which was less than 1% of her annual stipend.
cues.zh: 2000英鎊用於救濟飢荒，這還不到她每年津貼的1%。

cues.text: And when the Ottoman sultan wanted to donate £10,000,
cues.en: And when the Ottoman sultan wanted to donate £10,000,
cues.zh: 當奧斯曼蘇丹想要捐贈 10,000 英鎊時，

cues.text: the British Embassy talked him down to 1,000 so his generosity wouldn’t make Victoria look bad!
cues.en: the British Embassy talked him down to 1,000 so his generosity wouldn’t make Victoria look bad!
cues.zh: 英國大使館說服他把錢減少到 1,000，這樣他的慷慨就不會讓維多利亞難堪！

cues.text: Just like everything in her reign, Victoria cared more about her reputation than her people.
cues.en: Just like everything in her reign, Victoria cared more about her reputation than her people.
cues.zh: 就像她統治時期的一切一樣，維多利亞更關心她的聲譽而不是她的人民。

cues.text: She was actually very aware of how difficult her subjects’ lives were.
cues.en: She was actually very aware of how difficult her subjects’ lives were.
cues.zh: 她實際上非常清楚她的臣民的生活有多麼困難。

cues.text: As a child, her mother took her on tours around the UK to see how people lived.
cues.en: As a child, her mother took her on tours around the UK to see how people lived.
cues.zh: 小時候，她的母親帶她環遊英國，瞭解人們的生活方式。

cues.text: And as an adult, she read authors like Charles Dickens to better understand the lower classes.
cues.en: And as an adult, she read authors like Charles Dickens to better understand the lower classes.
cues.zh: 成年後，她閱讀了查爾斯狄更斯等作家的作品，以便更好地瞭解下層階級。

cues.text: She backed social reforms like the establishment of state-funded public schools
cues.en: She backed social reforms like the establishment of state-funded public schools
cues.zh: 她支援社會改革，例如建立國家資助的公立學校

cues.text: and the Public Health Act of 1875, which aimed to improve sanitation and living conditions.
cues.en: and the Public Health Act of 1875, which aimed to improve sanitation and living conditions.
cues.zh: 以及 1875 年的《公共衛生法》，旨在改善衛生和生活條件。

cues.text: While I'm sure those policies helped her domestic subjects,
cues.en: While I'm sure those policies helped her domestic subjects,
cues.zh: 雖然我確信這些政策對她的國內臣民有幫助，

cues.text: Victoria frequently ignored her countless more international citizens.
cues.en: Victoria frequently ignored her countless more international citizens.
cues.zh: 維多利亞經常忽視她無數的國際公民。

cues.text: She believed that Britain should be an empire over which the sun never set,
cues.en: She believed that Britain should be an empire over which the sun never set,
cues.zh: 她相信英國應該是日不落帝國，

cues.text: meaning she completely supported colonial expansion.
cues.en: meaning she completely supported colonial expansion.
cues.zh: 這意味著她完全支援殖民擴張。

cues.text: It’s true— Victoria was a product of her time and believed in Britain’s imperial destiny.
cues.en: It’s true— Victoria was a product of her time and believed in Britain’s imperial destiny.
cues.zh: 確實如此——維多利亞是她那個時代的產物，她相信英國的帝國命運。

cues.text: But she was also interested in learning about the various cultures within her empire,
cues.en: But she was also interested in learning about the various cultures within her empire,
cues.zh: 但她也有興趣瞭解她的帝國內的各種文化，

cues.text: developing close relationships with Sarah Forbes Bonnetta, a formerly enslaved West African woman,
cues.en: developing close relationships with Sarah Forbes Bonnetta, a formerly enslaved West African woman,
cues.zh: 與前被奴役的西非婦女莎拉·福布斯·博內塔 (Sarah Forbes Bonnetta) 建立了密切的關係，

cues.text: and with Abdul Karim, an Indian secretary who taught her Hindustani.
cues.en: and with Abdul Karim, an Indian secretary who taught her Hindustani.
cues.zh: 還有一位印度秘書阿卜杜勒·卡里姆（Abdul Karim），他教她印度斯坦語。

cues.text: Victoria and Albert were also known abolitionists who supported deploying the Royal Navy
cues.en: Victoria and Albert were also known abolitionists who supported deploying the Royal Navy
cues.zh: 維多利亞和阿爾伯特也是著名的廢奴主義者，他們支援部署皇家海軍

cues.text: to combat West Africa's illegal slave trade.
cues.en: to combat West Africa's illegal slave trade.
cues.zh: 打擊西非的非法奴隸貿易。

cues.text: Noble efforts, no doubt.
cues.en: Noble efforts, no doubt.
cues.zh: 毫無疑問，這是一項崇高的努力。

cues.text: But Victoria did nothing to counter the violent oppression
cues.en: But Victoria did nothing to counter the violent oppression
cues.zh: 但維多利亞沒有採取任何行動來反抗暴力壓迫

cues.text: and paternalistic racism that marked Britain's colonial expansion.
cues.en: and paternalistic racism that marked Britain's colonial expansion.
cues.zh: 以及標誌著英國殖民擴張的家長式種族主義。

cues.text: These colonies’ inhabitants were frequently mistreated, and they could only advance so far in their country’s government,
cues.en: These colonies’ inhabitants were frequently mistreated, and they could only advance so far in their country’s government,
cues.zh: 這些殖民地的居民經常受到虐待，他們在國家政府中只能取得如此大的進步，

cues.text: even if they were British educated.
cues.en: even if they were British educated.
cues.zh: 即使他們是在英國接受教育的。

cues.text: Let's not sugarcoat it.
cues.en: Let's not sugarcoat it.
cues.zh: 我們不要粉飾它。

cues.text: Under her watch, British forces brutally crushed uprisings
cues.en: Under her watch, British forces brutally crushed uprisings
cues.zh: 在她的領導下，英國軍隊殘酷鎮壓了起義

cues.text: in South Asia and Africa, looted resources, and enforced racial hierarchies that lasted long after her reign.
cues.en: in South Asia and Africa, looted resources, and enforced racial hierarchies that lasted long after her reign.
cues.zh: 在南亞和非洲，掠奪資源，並強制實施種族等級制度，這種制度在她統治後仍持續很長時間。

cues.text: Doesn’t exactly sound like a “big happy family” to me.
cues.en: Doesn’t exactly sound like a “big happy family” to me.
cues.zh: 對我來說，聽起來並不像是一個「幸福的大家庭」。

cues.text: Queen Victoria might have tried to hold her empire to a higher standard,
cues.en: Queen Victoria might have tried to hold her empire to a higher standard,
cues.zh: 維多利亞女王可能試圖讓她的帝國達到更高的標準，

cues.text: but should we judge leaders by their ideals or their outcomes?
cues.en: but should we judge leaders by their ideals or their outcomes?
cues.zh: 但我們應該根據領導者的理想還是結果來判斷他們呢？

cues.text: These are the questions we have to ask when putting history on trial.
cues.en: These are the questions we have to ask when putting history on trial.
cues.zh: 這些都是我們在審判歷史時必須提出的問題。
